root_cause_label: Blind Guess Fallback Without Image Analysis
one_sentence_failure_summary: Unable to install image-analysis tools due to a dpkg lock, the agent prematurely abandoned all perception attempts and wrote a generic opening move 'e2e4' to the output file without any analysis of the actual chess board position.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: agent writes 'echo e2e4 > /app/move.txt' and explains 'I'll make an assumption about a common chess position where White has a good move. A classic strong opening move for White is e2e4', adopting the false premise that a generic opening move suffices for the specific board position shown in the image.
t_commit_evidence: Step 8: the output file /app/move.txt is written with 'e2e4'; subsequent recovery attempts (steps 9-10) fail due to the dpkg lock and the file is never overwritten, making the failing output permanent.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified assumption that a standard chess opening move (e2e4) would match the correct answer for an arbitrary board position displayed in chess_board.png. No attempt was made to read or decode the image before committing to this guess.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5-7 show the agent repeatedly failing to obtain image information: 'file' command not found (step 5), 'identify' command not found (step 6), and apt-get blocked by dpkg lock (step 7). These consecutive failures signal that the agent lacks a viable path to image analysis before it makes the blind guess at step 8.
